mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion, while loperamide reduces GI motility and increases drug residence time in the bowel; combined use increases loperamide absorption and toxicity risk while impairing renal clearance.
action: Avoid loperamide during amphotericin B therapy; use alternative antidiarrheal agents only if essential and monitor renal function and loperamide levels closely.
